knowledge.title: AI Providers
knowledge.content: Solutions can integrate with AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, DeepSeek, and other compatible language models depending on project requirements.

knowledge.title: Messaging Platforms
knowledge.content: Applications can integrate with WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and email services for communication and automation.

knowledge.title: Payment Systems
knowledge.content: Payment integrations can include Stripe and PayPal for subscriptions, one-time payments, invoices, and webhook-driven workflows.

knowledge.title: Google Services
knowledge.content: Integrations can include Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google OAuth, and other Google APIs where appropriate.

knowledge.title: Microsoft Services
knowledge.content: Integrations can include Outlook, Microsoft OAuth, OneDrive, and Microsoft Graph APIs where appropriate.

knowledge.title: CRM Platforms
knowledge.content: CRM integrations can include HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, and custom CRM systems.

knowledge.title: Automation Platforms
knowledge.content: Automation workflows can connect with Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and custom webhook-based systems.

knowledge.title: Cloud Storage
knowledge.content: Applications can integrate with AWS S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and similar cloud storage services.

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: Authentication integrations can include Google Login, GitHub Login, Microsoft Login, OAuth, JWT, and role-based access control.

knowledge.title: Databases
knowledge.content: Supported databases include PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, and vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Qdrant, and Weaviate.

knowledge.title: Developer Tools
knowledge.content: Development workflows commonly use GitHub, Docker, REST APIs, GraphQL where appropriate, webhooks, and cloud deployment services.

knowledge.title: E-commerce
knowledge.content: Depending on project requirements, integrations with Shopify and other commerce platforms can be evaluated if suitable APIs are available.

faqs.question: Can you integrate OpenAI?
faqs.answer: Yes. OpenAI APIs can be integrated into chatbots, AI agents, SaaS platforms, automation systems, and backend services.

faqs.question: Can you integrate WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp Business API can be integrated for customer support, notifications, and automated messaging.

faqs.question: Can you integrate Stripe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Stripe can be integrated for subscriptions, one-time payments, invoices, and webhook-based payment workflows.

faqs.question: Can you integrate PayPal?
faqs.answer: Yes. PayPal payment flows can be integrated where they fit the project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you connect Google Sheets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google Sheets can be used for data synchronization, reporting, automation, and workflow integration.

faqs.question: Can you integrate HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Yes. HubSpot CRM can be connected for lead management, automation, and customer workflows.

faqs.question: Can you integrate Salesforce?
faqs.answer: Yes. Salesforce integrations can be developed based on project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you integrate Zapier or n8n?
faqs.answer: Yes. Automation platforms such as Zapier, n8n, and Make.com can be connected to streamline workflows.

faqs.question: Can you connect databases?
faqs.answer: Yes. PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, and vector databases are supported.

faqs.question: Can you integrate Shopify?
faqs.answer: If the required APIs are available and align with the project goals, Shopify integrations can be evaluated and implemented.

response_rules: Do not claim an integration has been implemented previously unless it is supported by the portfolio.
If a service provides documented APIs, explain that integration can be assessed based on project requirements.
Avoid promising compatibility where API limitations or licensing may apply.
